usage: The verb 學 means 'to learn' or 'to study'.
It can be used to describe acquiring new knowledge or skills.
學 is often followed by the object of learning, such as a subject or language.
It can be used in different tenses by adding time indicators or particles.
It is a common verb in daily conversations about education or self-improvement.
